Plumber costs are best summarized by scope: national hourly averages run about $45–$200, with averages around $105–$150 per hour across sources [d1,d4,d8]. Typical small repairs (e.g., faucets, sinks) average roughly $125–$350, while larger repairs or installations average $500–$800 [d9]. Regional and state rates differ; Florida shows averages near $330 per hour and common jobs $177–$483, and Texas reports $45–$200 per hour with example flat rates up to $2,000 for major work [d3,d5]. Service call fees and emergency rates add overhead, commonly $160–$225 depending on location and urgency [d2,d8]. Repair-type examples in the Houston area include bathtub, faucet, garbage disposal, and shower repairs with typical ranges [d6].
